answer: Autonomous agents at a smart shipping wharf register their identity by binding staking collateral to a recursive zero-knowledge reputation cipher. To prevent identity cloning, a sequential verifiable delay function acts as a cryptographic lantern, exposing malicious parallel generation by making the computational cost of Sybils prohibitive. With severe slashing penalties enforcing negative expected utility for equivocation, this framework secures a robust Nash equilibrium where honest behavior remains the only viable strategy.
